notices: FNSTools is a beta. If a download or install stalls, leave it as it is and send the Textport contents to Function Store on Discord or Patreon.

Core.pitch: The registries every other tool plugs into. Installed as a unit.

Surfaces.pitch: Window layout, operator colours, menus and preview panels.

Parameters.pitch: Promote, bind, randomize and reset, by drag and drop.

Network.pitch: Operator creation, replacement, grouping and network navigation.

Media & Output.pitch: Media playback, previews and audio and video output.

Control.pitch: MIDI, OSC and remote parameter control.

Workflow.pitch: Project setup, backups and everyday editing shortcuts.

Developer.pitch: Python extensions, type stubs and editor integration.

packages.name: FNS_AltSelect
packages.title: AltSelect
packages.description: Alternative selection helpers for operators in the network editor.

packages.name: FNS_AutoCombine
packages.title: AutoCombine
packages.description: Hold Alt while placing a generator TOP to have it come in pre-set to composite over its input.

packages.name: FNS_AutoRes
packages.title: AutoRes
packages.description: Hold Alt while placing a generator TOP to have its resolution follow the project (or the panel it sits in) instead of a hardcoded pixel size.

packages.name: FNS_Autosave
packages.title: Autosave
packages.description: Save the project on a timer without touching the timeline, honouring your increment and backup preferences, and skipping saves while you are performing.
packages.whatsnew: carries the current config registry code, which had been frozen several versions back on this tool.

packages.name: FNS_BackupCleaner
packages.title: BackupCleaner
packages.description: Every .toe backup TouchDesigner has written under a folder, grouped by the project that made them, with their size and an estimate of the hours they represent; send the ones you are done with to the recycle bin, or delete them outright.

packages.name: FNS_BeatMod
packages.title: BeatMod
packages.description: Beat-synced modulation on any parameter or ParGroup, locked to the timeline tempo: a wave, a channel of any CHOP, or a gesture you record by hand, gliding in instead of cutting. Tap tempo sets the global BPM, and a manager lists every modulator in the project.
packages.whatsnew: carries the current config registry code, which had been frozen several versions back on this tool.

packages.name: FNS_BorderlessTD
packages.title: BorderlessTD
packages.description: Borderless TouchDesigner window, plus timeline hiding.

packages.name: FNS_CamSequencer
packages.title: CamSequencer
packages.description: A camera with two preset sequencers inside, one for its transform and lens and one for the Look At target: frame it, append, scrub or drive it from a CHOP, fly it with a joystick, or take over a palette camera viewport.

family.summary: A camera that sequences between saved views: capture camera states as presets and step, mix or morph between them.

packages.whatsnew: the game controller is only switched on while you are mapping one or already have one mapped, so a project that never uses a joystick stops polling for one every frame.

packages.name: FNS_Collect
packages.title: Collect
packages.description: Gather every external file your project references into the project folder and rewrite the parameters to match, so the project travels. Shows the plan before it copies anything.

packages.name: FNS_ColorUI
packages.title: ColorUI
packages.description: Operator and family colour palettes, with the active palette roaming through config.

packages.name: FNS_CommandKit
packages.title: CommandKit
packages.description: Drop-in kit that lets ANY component publish quick-launch commands to the in-TouchDesigner command palette and the TDX launcher: decorate a promoted method, or declare a spec. Guarded: with no registry in the session nothing happens and nothing errors.

packages.name: FNS_CommandPalette
packages.title: CommandPalette
packages.description: A command palette inside TouchDesigner: every command your FNS tools declare and TouchDesigner's own palette components in one ranked list, opened with a hotkey and aware of what you are looking at. Manage favourites and hidden commands from its tab in Hub.
packages.whatsnew: carries the current config registry code, which had been frozen several versions back on this tool.

packages.name: FNS_CommandRegistry
packages.title: CommandRegistry
packages.description: Collects the commands your tools declare and serves them to whatever can run them: the in-TouchDesigner command palette and the TDX launcher. Discovery is by tag, so a tool installed before any consumer still appears the moment one arrives.

packages.name: FNS_ConfigHost
packages.title: ConfigHost
packages.description: A standalone ConfigRegistry host. Drop it into a component to give it roaming settings; its parameters save and reload with your config, with per-parameter and per-page exclusions.
packages.whatsnew: the settings file is `FNSTools/config/FNStools_config.json`.

packages.name: FNS_ConfigRegistry
packages.title: ConfigRegistry
packages.description: Settings persistence registry: one aggregated JSON in the user palette, so preferences follow you across projects and survive updates. The raw master, promoted to /sys.
packages.whatsnew: a tool whose config tooltip still named the old palette folder corrects itself when it loads.

packages.name: FNS_Console
packages.title: Console
packages.description: The toolkit's web front, served from inside your project: every tool's settings on one page, the install picker, and any tab a tool contributes. The raw master, promoted to /sys.

packages.name: FNS_CustomParTools
packages.title: CustomParTools
packages.description: Promote parameters to a parent with binds or expressions, customize name/label/range on drop, plus extension creation, parent shortcuts, parameter clearing and IOP promotion. Also carries the pane-bar drag-drop hijack and path-cell injection, and four stock-TouchDesigner shortcuts for opening parameters and the COMP editor.
packages.whatsnew: the extension template file is looked up under `FNSTools/scripts`.

packages.name: FNS_ExprHotStrings
packages.title: ExprHotStrings
packages.description: Abbreviations that expand into TouchDesigner expressions as you type in a parameter field.
packages.whatsnew: its table lives in `FNSTools/tables`.

packages.name: FNS_GlobalOutSelect
packages.title: GlobalOutSelect
packages.description: Browse Global OP Shortcuts and the out operators inside them in a tree, and drag any of them into a network as a Select.

packages.name: FNS_GlobalVolControl
packages.title: GlobalVolControl
packages.description: Global audio volume control.

packages.name: FNS_HotkeyManager
packages.title: HotkeyManager
packages.description: Unified hotkey discovery, conflict detection and rebinding UI across the whole toolkit.
packages.whatsnew: its gathered hotkeys table lives in `FNSTools/tables`.

packages.name: FNS_Hub
packages.title: Hub
packages.description: The FNS button in TouchDesigner's main-menu bar and the one-stop manager window behind it: the Toolbar, Navbar and Main Menu configurators as tabs, the console, and any tab a tool contributes. Drop a panel COMP on the button to register it into a surface.

packages.name: FNS_HubRegistry
packages.title: HubRegistry
packages.description: The registry behind Hub's tab bar: tools contribute native panels, viewers or parameter pages as hub tabs. The raw master, promoted to /sys.

packages.name: FNS_HydroHomie
packages.title: HydroHomie
packages.description: A toolbar reminder to drink water at an interval you set. Off by default.

packages.name: FNS_iopBrowser
packages.title: iopBrowser
packages.description: Browse the internal operators and the OP tree of the network you are in, from a popup opened off the pane bar. One browser instance serves every pane; the bar carries only the button.

packages.name: FNS_MainMenuRegistry
packages.title: MainMenuRegistry
packages.description: TD main-menu surface registry, including project-name display. The raw master, promoted to /sys.

packages.name: FNS_MediaBrowser
packages.title: MediaBrowser
packages.description: See every media file your project uses and which operator uses it, filter to the missing ones, and replace or repoint them in place.

packages.name: FNS_Misc
packages.title: Misc
packages.description: Three small toolbar utilities: a Background Viewer toggle for the network's backdrop TOPs and CHOPs, a global Mouse In CHOP you can drag channels from onto parameters, and a Hog CHOP for starving a patch of cook time to see how it copes.

packages.name: FNS_MixSequencer
packages.title: MixSequencer
packages.description: A step sequencer of mixes for OpSequencer: every step is a weight vector over a sequencer's presets, the playhead crossfades between steps with easing, and the result rides out as one channel per preset. A run of one-hot steps is a cue list.

family.summary: A step sequencer of mixes for the OpSequencer family: each step is a weight vector over presets, crossfaded with easing, out as one channel per preset.

packages.whatsnew: a nameless column can no longer break the preset list.

packages.name: FNS_NavbarRegistry
packages.title: NavbarRegistry
packages.description: The pane-bar surface registry. The raw master, promoted to /sys; clone it to add your own pane-bar widgets.

packages.name: FNS_OpenExt
packages.title: OpenExt
packages.description: Open an operator's extension source quickly.

packages.name: FNS_OpFamily
packages.title: OpFamily
packages.description: The FNS tab in the OP Create dialog: an operator family whose members are FNS tools placed from the store as one node each, with stubs for projects that travel and in-place updates that keep retained parameters and state. Built with TDFam.
packages.whatsnew: the FNS operator family has a new color, 0.5 0.5 0.

packages.name: FNS_OpMenuMods
packages.title: OpMenuMods
packages.description: OP Create dialog extras: IO filter buttons, your own search keywords per operator type, and acronym search (type m f o for Movie File Out).
packages.whatsnew: its tables live in `FNSTools/tables`.

packages.name: FNS_OpMenuRegistry
packages.title: OpMenuRegistry
packages.description: OP Create dialog surface registry: search words, row decorations, right-click items, filter stages. The raw master, promoted to /sys.

packages.name: FNS_OpSequencer
packages.title: OpSequencer
packages.description: Preset sequencer for one operator: store any number of its parameter states in a table, then scrub, jump or morph between them with easing, or mix them by weight from a CHOP. Drop the operator on the panel and drag parameters in to add columns.

family.summary: Preset sequencing for any operator: capture parameter states as presets and step, mix or morph between them from a CHOP.

packages.whatsnew: a column that lost its header is given its name back, so the preset list keeps working.

packages.name: FNS_OpTemplates
packages.title: OpTemplates
packages.description: A library of preconfigured operator templates to drop into a network.
packages.whatsnew: the global template library lives in `FNSTools/OpTemplates`.

packages.name: FNS_OpToClipboard
packages.title: OpToClipboard
packages.description: Copy the selected operator's reference to the system clipboard, ready to paste into an expression.

packages.name: FNS_Output
packages.title: Output
packages.description: A toolbar button for the perform window: drop an operator to route it, click to open or close, and switch NDI and Spout/Syphon streaming of the same window.

packages.name: FNS_PaletteRegistry
packages.title: PaletteRegistry
packages.description: Contribute tabs to TouchDesigner's Palette Browser: a tool publishes a native panel COMP and it appears beside the stock Palette tab, sized to the slot and notified on every tab change.

packages.name: FNS_PaneTypeRegistry
packages.title: PaneTypeRegistry
packages.description: Named, persistent pane-type entries for TD's panebar: any COMP can appear in the pane-type dropdown and be recalled with configurable owner, type, window actions and callbacks.

packages.name: FNS_ParentHierarchy
packages.title: ParentHierarchy
packages.description: Hover a parent in the pane-bar path with Alt to see its parent shortcut, global shortcut and internal operators, and Ctrl to see its custom parameters and values. Click any item to copy a reference to it. Adds no button of its own; it works on the path you already have.

packages.name: FNS_ParOPDrop
packages.title: ParOPDrop
packages.description: Create Parameter CHOP/DAT and Parameter Execute DAT nodes inside a COMP from its custom parameters, by drag and drop or hotkey.
packages.whatsnew: a drop no longer fails with UnboundLocalError when the held modifier and the latched CHOP flags disagree (after an extension reinit, for one); the placed operator is now decided by the same OS-level modifier check as the drop gate.

packages.name: FNS_ParRandomizer
packages.title: ParRandomizer
packages.description: Randomize parameter values within range, for quick exploration.

packages.name: FNS_PreviewPanel
packages.title: PreviewPanel
packages.description: A preview pane for whatever you drop on it: TOPs, POPs, SOPs, 3D textures, geometry, panels and other components render in place, and a POP can be opened as a live table or in its own viewer window.

packages.name: FNS_ProSceneChanger
packages.title: ProSceneChanger
packages.description: The Pro scene changer: everything SimpleSceneChanger does, plus per-scene modes, fade times and easing, a cue table with play, timeline, timecode and CHOP drivers, CHOP output blending, and fleet follow with scene offset and sync timing. Runs beside the simple one in the same fleet.

family.summary: The Pro scene changer: per-scene modes, fade times and easing, a cue table with play, timeline, timecode and CHOP drivers, CHOP output blending, fleet follow.

packages.whatsnew: ships without the authoring apparatus it had been carrying: no Version Ctrl page, no version-history tables, and it opens on its first parameter page.

packages.name: FNS_QuickCollapse
packages.title: QuickCollapse
packages.description: Collapse a selection into a component, with an optional customize dialog.

packages.name: FNS_QuickPane
packages.title: QuickPane
packages.description: Pane layout shortcuts.

packages.name: FNS_QuickTime
packages.title: QuickTime
packages.description: A toolbar clock that hands out drag-and-drop time references for parameters: resettable and scalable absTime and absFrame, frame, and a progress value for perfect loops.

packages.name: FNS_RandomCHOP
packages.title: RandomCHOP
packages.description: A random-value CHOP: uniform or normal distributions, unique re-rolls with a tolerance and history, a Markov chain mode, weights from an input and a trigger input, generated per channel or per sample. The first member of the FNS operator family and an alternative for the Noise CHOP.

family.summary: A random-value CHOP: uniform or normal distributions, unique re-rolls, a Markov chain mode, weights and a trigger from inputs.

packages.name: FNS_Remote
packages.title: Remote
packages.description: Control the project from your phone over your own network: parameter pages, a perform window and multi-touch, paired by QR with no cloud and no account.
packages.whatsnew: carries the current config registry code, which had been frozen several versions back on this tool.

packages.name: FNS_ResetPLS
packages.title: ResetPLS
packages.description: Reset stateful operators (feedback, cache, timers, counts) across the project, with a pattern-based exception list. Bound to ctrl+0.
packages.whatsnew: its tables live in `FNSTools/tables`.

packages.name: FNS_SearchPalette
packages.title: SearchPalette
packages.description: Search field for TouchDesigner's palette browser, installed into the palette on startup. Vendored TD-SearchPalette by Yea Chen.

packages.name: FNS_SetSmoothness
packages.title: SetSmoothness
packages.description: Set Input/Viewer Smoothness on selected TOPs, or on every TOP in the network.

packages.name: FNS_SimpleSceneChanger
packages.title: SimpleSceneChanger
packages.description: Scene changer for TOP outputs: wire your scenes in, then cut, fade or ease between them by select, timer, A/B fader or CHOP, with cooking control so only the scenes on screen cook. Base and Pro instances find each other and can follow a leader across screens.

family.summary: Crossfade between input scenes with one index, a fade time and an easing; a CHOP out follows the fade.

packages.whatsnew: ships without the authoring apparatus it had been carrying: no Version Ctrl page, no version-history tables, and it opens on its first parameter page.

packages.name: FNS_SwapOps
packages.title: SwapOps
packages.description: Swap one operator for another while keeping connections intact.

packages.name: FNS_SwitchOPs
packages.title: SwitchOPs
packages.description: One hotkey jumps focus back and forth between the last two operators you selected, across networks.

packages.name: FNS_SwitchTools
packages.title: SwitchTools
packages.description: A companion for any Switch, Cross or multi-input operator: index by slider, menu or bind, loop or clamp, colour the live input, cook only the inputs in use and unload the rest from the GPU, plus reorder, reverse, randomize and align the inputs.

family.summary: A companion for any Switch, Cross or multi-input operator: index by slider, menu or bind, loop or clamp, colour the live input, cook only the inputs in use.

packages.whatsnew: ships without the authoring apparatus it had been carrying: no Version Ctrl page, no version-history tables, and it opens on its first parameter page.

packages.name: FNS_TimelineRegistry
packages.title: TimelineRegistry
packages.description: Publish a widget into TouchDesigner's timeline bar: transport controls beside the stock ones, an entry on the time-properties block, or a full-width strip in the frame-ruler band that gets its own row.

packages.name: FNS_TimelineTools
packages.title: TimelineTools
packages.description: Drive the timeline from your media: pick a movie and an audio file, optionally resize the timeline to fit, and see them behind the ruler and the Keyframer graph as a filmstrip, a waveform and your editor's markers. Key any operators' parameters into an Animation COMP with one press, and play them back from it.

portability.path: <abs>/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mov

packages.name: FNS_ToolbarRegistry
packages.title: ToolbarRegistry
packages.description: The toolbar surface registry and mirror rail. The raw master, promoted to /sys; clone it to put your own tools on the bar.

packages.name: FNS_Updater
packages.title: Updater
packages.description: In-place toolkit updates, with settings preserved across the replacement.
packages.whatsnew: the popup that appeared on the first project open after an update is gone. The updater now says what landed in the Textport as the update finishes, which is where you already are, and nothing about an update happens on project start.

packages.name: FNS_VSCodeTools
packages.title: VSCodeTools
packages.description: VS Code integration: open externalized scripts, sync files and generate TouchDesigner type stubs.

packages.name: midiMapper
packages.title: midiMapper
packages.description: Map MIDI controls to parameters, with a learn mode you drive by dropping a parameter on the toolbar button. Mappings are saved into the project folder by design; the tool's own settings roam through config.

packages.name: oscMapper
packages.title: oscMapper
packages.description: Map OSC messages to parameters. Mappings are saved into the project folder by design.

packages.name: PasteFromClipboard
packages.title: PasteFromClipboard
packages.description: Paste the image on the clipboard into the current network as a Movie File In, a Script TOP or an annotation. Windows only.

packages.name: QuickMarks
packages.title: QuickMarks
packages.description: Bookmark network locations and jump back to them. Bookmarks stay project-local by design.

packages.name: TDXMap
packages.title: TDXMap
packages.description: MIDI controller mapping with a live web UI: multiple devices, banks, Smart Learn, button actions, 14-bit controls. Pro adds smoothing, pickup mode, easing curves, slot and modify modes.

pricing.detail: A free 14-day trial of Pro, once per computer. After it the mapping editor needs a Function Store Patreon membership at the Base or Pro tier, or a Gumroad lifetime key; live MIDI to parameters keeps working without one, and your mappings are kept.

Visual: buttons on the toolbar and pane bar, a manager window
The screen in front of me
Controlled from a phone or tablet

questions.prompt: Do you wire a lot of parameters?

options.label: Yes: promote, bind, randomize, reset, map controllers

options.label: Yes, with Python and custom parameters
